body:
This week, bring GitHub Enterprise Server repositories into the Copilot app and see which agent sessions need you first in VS Code. You can also try two new models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Gemini 4 Carbon.

## GitHub Copilot

• Claude Fable 5.2 is available to Copilot Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise users. It requires data retention by default, and Copilot Business and Enterprise administrators must turn on its policy, which is off by default. Learn more about Claude Fable 5.2 .

• Gemini 4 Carbon is available to Copilot Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise users.

## GitHub Copilot app

• Continue cloud and Codespace sessions on your phone. A new Open in menu includes a GitHub Mobile option that shows a QR code.

• Sign back in to MCP servers such as Slack without leaving the conversation. When a server needs you to sign in again, the conversation offers the matching connector, connects it in place, and resumes your task.

• Work with repositories, issues, and pull requests from GitHub Enterprise Server in the Copilot app, now generally available. You’ll still need a GitHub.com or GHE.com account, and cloud sessions aren’t available for GHES. Learn more about signing in with GHES .

• Schedule Project automations down to the minute, or use a custom cron schedule such as weekdays at 9:30.

• Dictate in French, Spanish, and other languages. Download the multilingual voice model in settings, then choose Auto or a specific language.

• Filter issues and pull requests by custom fields, such as a GitHub Project’s Size, from the Add filter menu.

• Combine high contrast with red, green, or blue-yellow color filters in Settings > Accessibility , and preview combinations before you apply them. High contrast replaces the separate “Increase contrast” setting. You can also choose GitHub Dimmed as a dark-only palette in Settings > Themes .

Install the GitHub Copilot app .

## GitHub Copilot in VS Code (1.146 release)

• Let an agent run model comparisons for you. With Compare Models enabled, turn on the agent tools in settings, and agents can find available models, launch comparisons, and read the results to summarize findings. This is experimental.

• Track agent sessions across all your workspaces from one view with Inbox mode in the Agents window’s sessions list. Sessions that need your attention appear first, and you can dismiss, hold, or snooze the rest. This is experimental.

• Move a chat out of the Agents window into its own window, then arrange the chat, its editors, and its terminals to fit the task. Chat windows are in preview.

• Find, install, and uninstall extensions without leaving the Agents window. Extensions with unsupported features show a warning before you install them. This is experimental.

• Move to the Copilot harness before the Local harness is removed in February 2027. The Copilot harness is already the default for new sessions, and the transition guide covers moving any remaining workflows.

Explore everything that’s new in the full release notes .

The post GitHub Copilot weekly releases — November 9 appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
ar_body:
نشرت GitHub ملخص إصدارات Copilot الأسبوعية، وفيه نموذجان جديدان وتحديثات لتطبيق Copilot وإضافة VS Code.

• نموذج Claude Fable 5.2 متاح لمستخدمي Copilot Pro+ وMax وBusiness وEnterprise. يتطلب الاحتفاظ بالبيانات افتراضيًا، وعلى مسؤولي Business وEnterprise تفعيل سياسته لأنها متوقفة افتراضيًا.
• نموذج Gemini 4 Carbon متاح للفئات نفسها.
• في تطبيق Copilot: متابعة جلسات السحابة وCodespace من الهاتف عبر رمز QR في GitHub Mobile، وإعادة تسجيل الدخول إلى خوادم MCP مثل Slack دون مغادرة المحادثة.
• أصبح العمل مع مستودعات GitHub Enterprise Server وقضاياها وطلبات الدمج متاحًا بشكل عام في التطبيق، مع بقاء الحاجة إلى حساب GitHub.com أو GHE.com، والجلسات السحابية غير متاحة لـ GHES.
• جدولة أتمتة المشاريع بالدقيقة أو بجدول cron مخصص، وإملاء صوتي بعدة لغات منها الفرنسية والإسبانية، وتصفية القضايا بالحقول المخصصة، وخيارات وصول جديدة تجمع التباين العالي مع مرشحات الألوان.
• في VS Code (الإصدار 1.146): ميزة تجريبية تتيح للوكيل تشغيل مقارنات بين النماذج، ووضع Inbox لتتبع جلسات الوكلاء عبر مساحات العمل وإظهار ما يحتاج انتباهك أولًا.

تعكس هذه التحديثات توسع Copilot نحو بيئات المؤسسات وتسهيل إدارة الوكلاء الأذكياء.
